annotations.title: Compare two windows against normal variation

description: Is a change real? Two windows of a metric (site, page, search, topic, device, channel or event), its change, and whether it is beyond the site's own normal variation, with a reading. Says when it cannot judge. Not why. Another organization's or an unconnected site answers not found. Read-only.

after_from.description: First day of the later window.

after_to.description: Last day of the later window (same length as the earlier one).

before_from.description: Instead of days: first day of the earlier window (give all four).

before_to.description: Last day of the earlier window.

channel.description: An Analytics channel, e.g. Organic Search, Direct.

metrics.description: Comma-separated: clicks, impressions, ctr, position, sessions, engaged_sessions, engagement_rate, conversions (default all).

page.description: One page, exactly as webops_pages returns it.

query.description: One search, as webops_searches returns it.

topic.description: A topic in a few words: the searches sharing its topic words.

name: webops_compare
title: Compare two windows against normal variation
